friction_log.issue: Fleet Guard enforces a strict naming convention: component name in uiExtensions[] must exactly match the .tsx filename. The scaffold generated MediaTestDashboardWidget.tsx but registered it in definition.ts as MediaTestWidget. This mismatch is invisible until deploy.
friction_log.resolution: Renamed the component entry in definition.ts from MediaTestWidget to MediaTestDashboardWidget to match the actual file.

success_patterns: Fleet Guard cold validation error message was precise and actionable.
13-step deploy pipeline with per-step status made it trivial to identify which phase blocked.
Bundle and manifest hashes in output provide instant diff visibility across deploys.
improvement_suggestions: The single highest-impact change would be a scaffold-time consistency check between uiExtensions[].component values in definition.ts and the actual .tsx filenames generated. Make definition.ts the single source of truth for component names and have the scaffold generator derive filenames from it.
